brief:
An Italian initiative is calling for Gaza's children to be awarded the Nobel Peace Prize, according to Shehab Wire. The campaign, launched by Professor Eugenio Mazzarella, has been promoted through columns in the newspaper Avvenire and reported by Italian daily Il Mattino.

The proposal seeks international recognition of the plight facing children in Gaza amid the ongoing conflict. Mazzarella's initiative represents an effort to draw global attention to the humanitarian situation affecting the youngest population in the territory.
